band.text: Reduced intake. Intake has been below this pet's baseline for 1 consecutive day . Baseline read over 24 recent rated meals. Recent rated meals declined: ate some → picked at it → ate some → picked at it. The most recent fully-eaten meal was Oct 14 — about 50 h without a full meal. In cats, ≥48–72 h of markedly reduced intake is a hepatic-lipidosis risk window. Recorded as a health signal — not “picky.” Meal-by-meal detail on the sheet headed “Intake per feeding”.
